riskAssessment.method: conservative keyword screening of recent public publication feeds; not validation of claims or an incident count
riskAssessment.status: 3 relevant publication signal(s) in the last 14 days across 4/4 available feeds. Reports may cover the same incident. This is a provisional publication-screening indicator, not a global danger measurement.
riskAssessment.warning: Green never means safe. Amber means publications merit human checking. Orange and Red require independent documented human review and cannot be selected automatically.

limitations: Publication feeds may be delayed, incomplete, duplicated, or unavailable.
Keyword matches are imperfect, can be wrong, and are not independently verified incidents.
Two publishers discussing the same event are not two independent incidents; publication totals do not count incidents.
No model internals or real-time incident sensors are monitored.
No automatic emergency messages, red warnings, or regulatory submissions.
